reasons: Datadog system.io.util is a disk utilization percentage (0-100); system.disk.io_time is a monotonic sum of busy seconds, so avg(rate(...)) yields a 0-1 ratio. This is the same underlying quantity with a percent-vs-ratio unit scale of 100, which the converter must not apply in promql. Note the scale and link the OTel disk metric documentation in notes.

Aggregation (avg across devices/series) and the absence of grouping match the Datadog query, and $scope with default * is correctly dropped. rate() is valid because system.disk.io_time is a monotonic sum with otel_metric_type sum.
Outcome translated is correct since the metric exists in the dataset and no Datadog function is involved.
